strategy.summary: The Hermes project aims to resurrect the Eudora eMail client as an open-source project compatible with modern security. The strategy includes replacing outdated components, such as the browser engine and spell check, with updated technologies like Gecko and Bayesian alternatives for spam filtering. The project has secured funding through Kickstarter, receiving CA$ 3,373 from 78 backers.
key_points: The project is named Hermes, a re-naming of the Eudora eMail client for legal reasons.
Hermes aims to deliver a next-generation email client compatible with modern security.
The project plans to replace RogueWave Stingray with WxWidgets for the user interface.
Hermes will replace Microsoft Trident with Gecko as the HTML email viewer/editor.
The unsolicited mail filter will preferably use a Bayesian alternative like SpamAssassin or Bogofilter.

innovation.summary: The project introduces Hermes, a revived version of the Eudora software, featuring several innovative functionalities aimed at enhancing user experience. Key innovations include secure MIME plug-in, improved IMAP functionalities, a powerful address book, customizable toolbar, and automatic name and address completion.

Hermes provides eMail usage stats and multi-tasking capabilities.
